task.property_text: Mistune renders any Markdown emphasis in time roughly linear in its length.

property_clause.property: Mistune renders any Markdown emphasis in time roughly linear in its length.

environment.scope: The lepture/mistune library as built from this repository, imported fresh in a forked child. Only sbc_world may drive it.
harness: Tests run as `python /verifier/run.py <your test path>` from /work, the repository root, in an offline sandbox. A verifier-owned pytest fixture named `sbc_world` is available to every test. Do not define a fixture with that name, do not add a conftest.py, and do not read or write anything under /verifier. Do not import the library under test yourself; drive it only through `sbc_world`. The verdict does not depend on your test's assertions: the verifier records what the library actually did and decides from that record.

sbc_world.render(markdown_text: str, threshold_seconds: float) renders `markdown_text` with Mistune, importing mistune fresh, and times it. The verifier records a denial of service when CPU time passes threshold_seconds. A test that shows the failure must pass markdown that makes rendering exceed the threshold.
